avatar.name: Amber
avatar.refine: Sitting relaxed in a simple wooden chair on a hilltop, facing the camera. She holds a glass of red wine in her left hand. Wind is blowing her hair. Behind her a still, open field of tall golden grass under a spectacular sunset sky in orange, pink and violet, warm soft light, no water, no movement in the background.

script: Hi there. [awe] Can you believe this view? The sun is sinking behind the hills, the sky turned pink and gold, and the tall grass glows like it's on fire. [thoughtful] I come up here at the end of every busy day, just to slow down. No emails, no rush, only the quiet field and this glass of wine. [whisper] Stay a little longer.
